device.title: This device
device.info: Applies to this tablet or phone only.
device.groupInfo: What this device is called in the band and which language it speaks.
device.name: Device name
device.lookInfo: Colours, text and the bar at the top.
device.textSizeInfo: Applies to prompter, live queue, show notes and system status - each widget can override it in its “⋯” menu.
device.pedalsInfo: Bluetooth pedal or keyboard: show, sections, playback, prompter and device commands - momentary, latching or timed.
device.mappingInfo: Pair a Bluetooth pedal (e.g. AirTurn, PageFlip) like a keyboard, then add mappings here. Works on the dashboards. Show and sections are controlled only by whoever may control the show (the master); device commands and prompter paging work on every device.
device.flashInfo: Messages from the stage messenger and hints from the song text ({alert: …}) large across the screen.
device.soundInfo: How this device plays track, click and announcements.
device.outputInfo: Split puts the click on one side of the headphone or line output only and the track (in mono) on the other. With a Y cable or a stereo DI the click side goes to the in-ear mix, the track side to the PA - the audience hears no click. Applies to click and announcements everywhere and to the track in Gig. In Solo practice and the timeline editor the track still plays through an audio element and stays on both sides.
device.storageInfo: Which audio files this device keeps for the songs.
device.appInfo: Version of the StageBoard app and updates from the Stage server.

server.title: Stage server
server.info: This device's connection and what the server does for the whole band.
server.connectionInfo: Which Stage server this device talks to and whether the band data is in sync.
server.activeBandInfo: Which band the Stage server's hardware is using right now. A change affects every device.
server.backupInfo: How the Stage server backs up the band data, and snapshots to take along.

statusBar.orderExplain: Top = more important. When it gets tight, items disappear from the bottom first. Always there and so not in the list: menu (☰), on dashboards the dashboard picker (nine dots), status icon, song title and play time; faults always show their word.
statusBar.title: Status bar

flash.bannerHint: A see-through strip at the top, until tapped or {{seconds}} seconds - the rest stays usable.
flash.fullscreenHint: Across the whole screen, until tapped or {{seconds}} seconds.
flash.offHint: No flash messages on this device.

routing.label: Output
routing.mixedDetail: Track, click and announcements on both sides - as before.
routing.clickLeftDetail: Click and announcements left, the track in mono right.
routing.clickRightDetail: Click and announcements right, the track in mono left.

sync.label: Storage & sync
sync.tooBig: Catalogue too big for “Complete” (more than {{percent}}% of the available storage)
sync.stemsInfo: None: only the stems being practised right now - loaded from the Stage server. Selective: stems of the active setlist and pinned songs. Complete: all.

app.updateFailed: The update could not be loaded - try again later. ({{reason}})
app.devUpdates: Updates for the development build come via adb. The real app gets its updates from the Stage server.
app.current: Up to date - the Stage server has no newer version.
app.none: The Stage server offers no app (or can't be reached).
